description: This Java source file defines the TestModuleController class, which is a Spring MVC controller for handling web requests related to the 'testmodule' in the OpenMRS project. It includes a single endpoint '/module/testmodule/hello' that returns a greeting string obtained from the TestModuleService.

classes.name: TestModuleController
classes.description: A Spring MVC controller for the testmodule, handling HTTP GET requests to the '/module/testmodule/hello' endpoint and returning a greeting.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Handles GET requests to '/module/testmodule/hello' and returns a string from the TestModuleService.
